title: BOOHTACORD | Media QoE
description: Private diagnostic source; source implementation is not deployed acceptance.

options.content: Client report distributions use 5m windows, separate platform/direction/stage. Unknown, stale, unsupported and legacy are not healthy zero. Client report is a diagnostic estimate, not SFU truth or moving-source SLO proof. Target is reported intent; capture settings are separate private trace fields. Static/hidden/SDK-paused/no-subscriber sessions are not a healthy moving-source denominator. Private filters do not replace Grafana/Tempo ACL; no public snapshots. Report state cohorts waiting_subscription/waiting_first_frame/playing/stalled are kept separate; playing does not prove motion or subscriber count.

panels.title: Reported actual FPS p05 by actual stage
panels.description: client report; encoded/decoded/presented separated. Never sum layer FPS; legacy excluded, current age gated. Frame dimensions are the client-reported sender measurement / receiver video-element geometry; exact capture/encode/delivery provenance requires #159. Quantile is a histogram bucket estimate, not an exact percentile.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.05, sum by(le,platform,direction,state,age_provenance,stage) (rate(boohtacord_media_fps_bucket{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m]))) >= 0) and on(platform,direction) ((time() - max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_report_received_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_known) == 1) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_at_receipt_seconds) <= 5))

panels.title: Sample mean reported target FPS
panels.description: client report target intent, not applied encoder or delivered FPS. Arithmetic sample mean, not histogram interpolation or applied intent. Mixed targets can give a mean between profiles; exact per-report target is in private samples.

targets.expr: ((sum by(platform,direction,state,age_provenance) (rate(boohtacord_media_target_fps_sum{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m])) / sum by(platform,direction,state,age_provenance) (rate(boohtacord_media_target_fps_count{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m]))) and on(platform,direction,state,age_provenance) (sum by(platform,direction,state,age_provenance) (rate(boohtacord_media_target_fps_count{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m])) > 0)) and on(platform,direction) ((time() - max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_report_received_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_known) == 1) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_at_receipt_seconds) <= 5))

panels.title: Paired actual / target FPS p05
panels.description: Paired positive target only, stage and population preserved. Diagnostic discrepancy below .9; not approved SLO paging. Missing target is unknown. Quantile is a histogram bucket estimate, not an exact percentile.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.05, sum by(le,platform,direction,state,age_provenance,stage) (rate(boohtacord_media_fps_target_ratio_bucket{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m]))) >= 0) and on(platform,direction) ((time() - max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_report_received_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_known) == 1) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_at_receipt_seconds) <= 5))

panels.title: Sample mean reported dimensions / target short edge
panels.description: client report; actual min(width,height), target numeric short edge. Capture settings are not actual encode dimensions. Frame dimensions are the client-reported sender measurement / receiver video-element geometry; exact capture/encode/delivery provenance requires #159. Arithmetic sample mean, not histogram interpolation or applied intent. Mixed targets can give a mean between profiles; exact per-report target is in private samples.

panels.description: Paired short-edge ratio only; aspect/scale policy and applied descriptor unavailable in legacy reports. Quantile is a histogram bucket estimate, not an exact percentile.

targets.expr: (histogram_quantile(0.05, sum by(le,platform,direction,state,age_provenance) (rate(boohtacord_media_resolution_target_ratio_bucket{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}",age_provenance="known"}[5m]))) >= 0) and on(platform,direction) ((time() - max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_report_received_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_known) == 1) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_seconds) < 60) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_at_receipt_seconds) <= 5))

panels.title: Current measurement age
panels.description: Server receipt age plus reported sample age. Missing age is legacy, not zero. >60s is stale.

targets.expr: max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_seconds{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}"}) and on(platform,direction) (max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_sample_age_known{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}"}) == 1)

panels.title: Last report receipt age
panels.description: Server clock; anonymous latest population receipt, not per-user/session activity. Stopped reporting can mean intentional viewer closure.

targets.expr: time() - max by(platform,direction) (boohtacord_media_report_received_seconds{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}"})

panels.title: Reports: fresh / stale / legacy
panels.description: fresh <=5s at receipt, stale >5s, legacy sample age unreported. Counts samples, not viewers.

targets.expr: sum by(platform,direction,state,freshness) (rate(boohtacord_media_reports_total{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}"}[5m]))

panels.title: Fields: present / missing / stale
panels.description: Missing fields do not create histogram observations. Availability is a diagnostic reason, not a capability claim. Presence denominators combine report states; stages/roles remain separate. Omitting state here bounds this instrument below SDK cardinality cap.

targets.expr: sum by(platform,direction,field,stage,role,availability) (rate(boohtacord_media_field_reports_total{platform=~"${platform:regex}",direction=~"${direction:regex}"}[5m]))

panels.title: Reported connection quality
panels.description: Fixed quality codes, legacy provenance kept. Client reported quality, not SFU transport classification.

panels.title: Adaptation reports by bounded reason
panels.description: Number of reports carrying cpu/bandwidth/other/none/unreported. This is not a downgrade/recovery event counter.

panels.title: Dependency fields unavailable in this source

options.content: Unsupported #159 fields: sender per-layer bitrate/FPS, codec/layer plan, encode time/limitation, applied vs requested vs delivered revision, receiver decode time and transport class. Existing contract only emits total bitrate and aggregate actual stages. First-frame/switch distributions and freeze duration/ratio are NOT emitted by report API; opt-in journey recorder is local QA, not an exporter. Downgrade/recovery event count is unavailable. #171 SFU CPU/throttling/NIC/UDP-drop container attribution is unavailable; host CPU alone is not SFU CPU. No freeze/first-frame/saturation rule is fabricated; complete dependent field rollout before enabling agreed #157 SLO paging.

panels.title: Private correlated samples for selected metric population
panels.description: Private client report samples, up to 100 spans in selected interval, configured retention 168h (sampling/export failure can omit spans). Metric population only narrows candidates; it cannot identify the offending user. Trusted server user/session allow drilldown to existing Traces UID; ACL remains mandatory.

targets.query: { resource.service.name = "boohtacord-api" && name = "media.sample" && span.user.id != nil && span.session.id != nil && span.media.platform =~ "${platform:regex}" && span.media.direction =~ "${direction:regex}" } | select(span.user.id,span.session.id,span.media.platform,span.media.direction,span.media.measurement_source,span.media.encoded_fps,span.media.decoded_fps,span.media.presented_fps,span.media.frame_width,span.media.frame_height,span.media.capture_width,span.media.capture_height,span.media.capture_fps,span.media.target_fps,span.media.target_resolution,span.media.bitrate_kbps,span.media.packet_loss_percent,span.media.packet_loss_window_ms,span.media.rtt_ms,span.media.jitter_ms,span.media.dropped_frames,span.media.packets_lost,span.media.connection_quality,span.media.adaptation_reason,span.media.sample_age_ms)

options.content: Versioned client spans already use app.media.session.id / app.flow.id, operation/retry/outcome; open existing BOOHTACORD | Traces for publisher->viewer/quality-revision review. Legacy server media.sample has authenticated user/session but no media-session, layer or revision. Temporal proximity is not causal proof. Existing Traces UID boohtacord-traces remains solely owned by #155.
